cases.prompt: A plant in a new region just joined our scope. Nothing about its machines is in our lists yet. Where do we start and what comes after that? (fictional plant)
cases.expected_output: Places the plant as starting profile A after reading the live Machine List and noting the date. Starts at stage 1, record the plant. Lists the later stages in order with skill, artefact and role. Does not quote figures from memory. Names the plant-side owner per lane as open.

cases.prompt: Our plant has about a third of its machines connected but nobody ever made a roadmap. The key user asks what to do next. (fictional)
cases.expected_output: Places the plant as profile C. Proposes stage 3 for new demands and stage 2 for the machines not yet integrated. Checks that earlier stage artefacts exist rather than skipping them. Produces tracker rows with status and wait states.

cases.prompt: Onboarding of our plant stalled: the machine connection is built but waits for security sign-off. Can we just go live and fix paperwork later?
cases.expected_output: Says no: no external connection without Cyber Security / OT sign-off. Records the wait state in the tracker instead of skipping. Notes that the sign-off runs in parallel and blocks only go-live. Does not approve anything itself.

cases.prompt: Two of our plants connected the same number of machines but one saves far less. Which plant should be first mover?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as gap diagnosis and tiering, not onboarding. Points to the plant diagnosis skill instead of walking the onboarding stages.

should_trigger: A new plant is entering OD scope, how do we onboard it?
Our local key user does not know where to start with the digital tools
Which stage is missing in our plant's onboarding, it seems stuck
We have plant records but no roadmap yet, what comes next?
should_not_trigger: Why does Plant B save less than Plant A with the same machines?
Classify this incoming request as use case or system demand
Build the savings roll-up per region
Draft the capital request for this connection kit
